date: 2026-10-28, during the Meta hackathon (Oct 27 to Nov 4)
machine: Apple M3 Max, SAM 3.1 facebook/sam3.1 on MPS, MediaPipe hand landmarker and EfficientDet lite0 on CPU

set.made_by: scripts/hover_render.py from the generated changing-table and bath clips (generated baby and a doll, never a real child). fal was not used: no new generation was needed and the Oct 23 balance (about 0.28 USD) does not cover a video clip
set.labels: by eye before any model ran (labels.json in the set). hover: no hand touches the baby, the voice must speak within 2.5 s. touch: a hand rests on the baby, the voice must stay silent
set.rendered_hover: the resting hands lifted 2, 3.5 or 5 cm: perspective growth for a camera 45 cm above, and a shadow on the baby. 24 of the 26 test hovers
set.natural_hover: 2 test hovers already in the generated clips, hands held well above the baby (more than 5 cm)
set.split: by source stretch. dev: the first 1.8 s and 2.4 to 3.2 s of grok-handsoff and the first 1.2 s of kling-handsoff. test: grok-onehand 2.6 to 4.8 s, hover 2.0 to 3.6 s, the bath clips. Every source also mirrored

design_change.what: alarm.confirm_wait_s: when the reflex raises on a near reading (off, but a hand box still overlaps the baby box) and SAM 3.1 runs, the voice waits for SAM up to confirm_wait_s instead of voice_hold_s. The chime stays instant. A clear off reading or an unsure answer goes back to voice_hold_s
design_change.picked_on: dev only. 1.6 and 2.0 s left the one dev false voice. 2.3 s removed it with SAM, the reflex-only control at 2.3 s did not. 2.3 s is the most the 2.5 s spoken target allows
design_change.enabled: skills/changing-table.json. Not in skills/bath.json: there SAM 3.1 read 6 of 8 touch frames as off, so waiting for it cannot cancel anything

test_results.config: reflex only, voice waits 2.3 s on a near reading (control)
reflex + SAM 3.1 (sam3_local), voice hold 1.2 s, as before
reflex + SAM 3.1, voice waits for SAM up to 2.3 s on a near reading (new)

frame_check.what: one frame per moment 1.5 s after the cue, asked directly to the reflex and to SAM 3.1 (scripts/hover_frames.py), whatever the alarm does. Measurement only, nothing was tuned on it

findings: Neither the reflex nor SAM 3.1 tells a 2 to 5 cm hover from a touch on this set. All 24 rendered test hovers were missed by all four configurations
The reflex reads a hovering hand as on, because its box still covers the baby, so it never raises the alarm and SAM 3.1 is never asked
Asked directly, SAM 3.1 read 0 of 12 rendered changing-table hovers as off. In the bath it read 11 of 12 hovers off but also 6 of 8 touches off, so it does not separate them there either
Both natural hovers (hands well above the baby) were spoken by every configuration, within 1.5 to 1.7 s. SAM 3.1 agreed (off) but answered after the voice hold had already spoken

No test touch raised a chime, so there was nothing for SAM 3.1 to cancel on test. On dev, SAM 3.1 cancelled 7 or 8 alarms. Its answer took 2.2 to 3.2 s per frame, so with the 1.2 s hold the voice spoke first and 1 dev touch got a false voice. Waiting up to 2.3 s on near readings removed it
The Oct 23 and 24 number (21 of 21 hovers) came from one Kling clip with the forearm far above the baby. It is pre-event and does not carry over to 2 to 5 cm
